subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: proposed log retention amendment & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@bigbank.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Long <samantha.long@bigbank.com>, procurement@bigbank.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation + log retention requirement for renewal

Hi Priya,

As we approach our September renewal, legal has pushed back with an ask: our auditors require a 5-year log retention window for certain auth and access logs that sit inside Redwood’s hosted control plane. Current contract language and the attestation scope you shared last quarter show a 1-year retention window.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide:
- a firm plan (technical + timeline) to extend relevant audit logs to 5 years,
- evidence artifacts that the SOC 2 auditor can consume (export format, sampling cadence), and
- any pricing or term changes that would be necessary (capacity, storage, seats).

We are also evaluating a modest seat expansion and want to fold that into the renewal amendment if possible. Legal would like an initial response by COB Monday to scope internally.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Moreno
Director, Security & Compliance
Big Bank Corp

On Thu, Sep 2, 2026 at 4:03 PM Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks — looping you in. Alex from Big Bank needs a quick but concrete plan for a 5-year audit log retention carveout and a pricing delta for capacity/storage.

Quick technical summary / constraints:
- We currently persist control-plane audit logs in a 12-month primary retention (S3) with lifecycle to Glacier after 12 months. Last quarter we shipped export hooks for raw NDJSON and CSV sampling.
- To support 5 years without materially affecting serving latency, we should: 1) enable long-term immutable archival (Glacier Deep Archive w/ versioning) for the control-plane auth/access logs, and 2) add a retention-index service to map event ranges to physical archive objects (this supports auditor sampling).
- Estimated infra work: ~4 weeks engineering (ingestion + lifecycle policies) + 2 weeks for the retention-index and sample export endpoints. QA + SOC evidence packaging: 2 weeks. Total: 8 weeks (60 business days is conservative; can be accelerated with a short dedicated sprint).
- Storage cost estimate (ballpark for Big Bank volumes as discussed in Q2): ~$6k/month in archival; delta vs current ~ $4.5k/month. I’ll call out a detailed estimate in the attached retention-cost-estimate.xlsx.

Operational deliverables we can provide to the auditor:
- NDJSON CSV export samples (field mapping documented)
- Integrity hashes for archived objects (SHA256) and timestamped manifest
- Exported access control lists (who had access) and key rotation records for the period requested

Risks / notes:
- If legal insists on immediate retroactive retention for logs beyond what we currently archive, we need an agreed RPO/RTO and an allowance for re-ingestion/restore costs.
- Dedicated capacity is not strictly required for retention changes, but if they opt for on-prem/VPC Private deployment or expanded throughput tied to seat growth, that will change contract terms.

I can finalize a technical appendix to include in the customer-facing proposal.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Engineering Manager, Infra | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation + log retention requirement for renewal

Hi Alex — thanks for raising this and for the clear requirements. Summary of what Redwood can commit to and next steps: 

1) Scope & deliverables (what we will provide)
- Extend control-plane auth/access log retention to 5 years via immutable archival (Glacier Deep Archive) with SHA256 manifests and an auditor-ready export endpoint (CSV/NDJSON) for sampled windows.
- Provide an evidence bundle: soc2-evidence-index.csv (fields listed), five sample exports (NDJSON + CSV), access-control ACL export, and key-rotation history for the requested window.
- Technical appendix from Karthik describing lifecycle and hashing.

2) Timeline
- Engineering sprint + infra changes: ~8 weeks (we propose Sept 13 start -> Nov 8 finish).
- Evidence prep sprint: 2 weeks following completion (Nov 9 -> Nov 23).
- Total delivery: Nov 23, 2026 (we can accelerate if you sign the amendment to cover expedited engineering costs).

3) Commercials / contract changes
- Retention amendment: add a retention rider to the MSA to reflect 5-year audit logs (one-time amendment).
- Pricing: estimated delta of $4,500/month in storage cost for archival and $2,000 one-time evidence packaging fee. If Big Bank also commits to the planned seat expansion (additional 25 seats), we can discount the monthly delta by 25% and offer a one-time credit for the evidence fee.

4) Next steps for Big Bank
- Please confirm if you’d like the expedited option (accelerated delivery for additional one-time fee).
- If agreed, procurement can issue a PO to the HubSpot deal (link below) and we’ll route the amendment through DocuSign: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BB-1147 and https://www.docusign.com/sign/BB-1147-amend

Attachments: soc2-evidence-index.csv, log-retention-change-proposal.docx, retention-cost-estimate.xlsx

If those terms look okay, we’ll have Legal draft the simple retention rider and ben will prep the commercial terms.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
